map.不可能。若父母均为纯合 IAIA 或杂合 IAi，子代只能获得 IA 或 i，表: Impossible. If both parents are homozygous IAIA or heterozygous IAi, the offspring can only receive IA or i, so the phenotype can only be A or O, never B or AB. If a contradiction appears, check for blood type testing error or non-paternity.
map.不靠谱。血型与性格无科学关联，本工具的「性格解读」仅为娱乐参考。医学上血型真正的: Unreliable. There is no scientific link between blood type and personality, so the "personality reading" here is for entertainment only. In medicine the real meaning of blood type lies in transfusion compatibility and the risk of haemolytic disease of the newborn (an Rh-negative mother carrying an Rh-positive fetus needs monitoring).
